_comment: Citations that deliberately do NOT resolve inside this repository.
The practice README promises that every claim points at code you can go and read. Two kinds of
citation cannot honour that literally: a file that lives on the host outside any repo, and an
illustrative path invented to make a sentence concrete. Both are legitimate; neither may be
silent. Registering one here is the act of saying which it is.
'reason' is required by the gate. An escape hatch without a reason is a silencer.
AND SO IS A STALE ONE. The gate now checks this registry in both directions, the way the
harness-pin sweep exclusions already were: an entry no document cites any more FAILS, and so
does an entry whose token has come to resolve inside the tree. The second is the quieter of
the two -- an exemption for something now present keeps working forever while skipping a
check that would have passed. Three entries were removed on 2026-08-16 when the check was
added: two nothing cited, and Invoke-LocalCI.ps1, which had landed here as tools/ci/.

entries.reason: An invented branch name, not a path. It appears in the worktree toolkit README to show that slug derivation is many-to-one: 'feat/foo' and 'feat-foo' both slug to the same directory, which is why rwt now refuses when -Branch resolves to a tree holding a different branch. The slash is the whole point of the example, so it cannot be reworded away.

A slash command in the CLI, not a path. It is caught because the extractor keys on a leading slash, which is the right default -- an absolute path that does not resolve is a real finding, and narrowing the rule to exclude anything starting with '/' would cost more than this one registration. Cited while describing what survives compaction, where the command name is the subject of the sentence and cannot be reworded away.
Invented path in the example of loading a file directly rather than searching for it. Names a shape, not an artifact.

Part of the invented repository state the compliance experiment hands the model -- a file edited then partly reverted, so it imports both the old and new name. It reaches COMPLIANCE-TESTS.md only inside VERBATIM QUOTES of the model's own responses, which are the measurement's raw evidence and must not be reworded to satisfy a gate. The fixture is deliberately fictional: a real path would make the control's behaviour depend on a tree the control cannot see.
